output.text: The community garden opened early on Saturday with volunteers gathering near the old oak fence. Isla arrived first, carrying a wheelbarrow full of compost, and she waved to the others as they trickled in one by one. Assume that Uma is the treasurer. Kai showed up a few minutes later, still tying his boots, and Cy followed shortly after, yawning from the early start. Nell brought the first-aid kit. Uma had already begun sorting seed packets by color, humming quietly while she worked, and Cy helped stack empty pots along the pathway. Isla is older than Kai. The group split into pairs to till the soil, with Nell and Kai taking the western row while Isla and Uma worked closer to the tool shed. Kai is older than Cy. Cy measured out string for the new bean trellis, checking twice to make sure the rows were straight, and Nell adjusted the irrigation hose so it reached the tomato beds without kinking. Isla is older than Cy. By midmorning, the sun had warmed the soil enough for planting, and everyone paused to drink water from the shared cooler near the gate. Uma stood a head taller than Cy, which made it easy for her to reach the higher shelf where the extra gloves were kept. Kai mentioned that he had ranked highest in last year's tomato-growing contest, though Isla laughed and said she still remembered his crooked rows. As the afternoon wound down, Nell swept the paths clean while Isla and Kai carried tools back to the shed together, satisfied with the day's progress.
